name: Ember Token
blurb: When you would fall in a fight, it burns instead and you rise with {hpPct}% of your max HP.

$note.hpPct: The percent of your max HP a revive token leaves you with when it burns, from 1 to 100.
$note.cost: What one costs at the market, in cinders.
$note.sellValue: What the market pays you for one. Never above its price, so buying and selling back never profits.
